positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed data orchestration system using asynchronous queue-based cloud-hosted microservice architecture.

Built responsive, stateful, single-page frontends using React.js.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Camel · Spring Boot · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Built shopping widget for Alexa multi-modal devices (devices with screens) using cloud-based Java microservice architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a cloud-hosted supply-chain distribution ERP using Agile methodology.

Improved scalability and reduced hosting costs of legacy application by migrating to multi-tenant containerized architecture on AWS ECS.

Cut deployment times by 90% by profiling and optimizing CI/CD pipeline.

Improved team efficiency by producing documentation and delivering month-long presentation series on software design principles.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Linux · Perl · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a .NET / React.js / MongoDB single-page web app using Agile methodology.

Built ETL pipeline to ingest terabytes of rich text documents on an ongoing basis.

Helped team understand requirements by creating data visualizations with D3.js.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed enterprises-grade Linux / Apache / Perl / PostgreSQL ERP web app as sole developer.

Built responsive, efficient dashboard using SQL and D3.js to demonstrate software’s positive impact on warehouse distributor shipping metrics.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved user experience by adding accessibility features to plain HTML / jQuery web app frontend.

Extended Perl-based EDI document translation engine to support new document types and meet customer requirements.
